name: Spinner
intent: A small ring of ticks in the brand color that turns while something loads and the wait is short and unknown.
usage: Use Spinner for a short wait with no known end, in the spot that is loading: a panel refreshing, a list fetching more, a Drawer loading a record. It is one component: pick a size. label is read by screen readers (Loading by default); showLabel writes it next to the ring, like Loading invoices…. For a button that is working, use Button loading. For content with a known layout, use Skeleton; for a known amount done, use Progress; for a line of status text, use ShimmerText. See contracts/spinner.json for the full contract.

label.note: What is loading, for screen readers, like Loading invoices. Empty makes the Spinner decorative, when the text beside it already says it.

showLabel.note: Writes the label to the right of the ring.

useWhen: A short wait with no known end, in the place that is loading.
A panel, list or Drawer fetching data where the layout is not known yet.
doNot: Do not put it in a Button. Use Button loading.
Do not use it when the amount done is known. Use Progress.
Do not use it for content with a known layout. Use Skeleton.
Do not use more than one for the same wait.
a11y: role status with the label, so the wait is announced once when the Spinner appears.
The ring is hidden from screen readers.
No motion when the person prefers reduced motion: the ticks stay still.

examples.title: With a label
examples.usage: showLabel writes the label beside the ring.
